You can now comment on lines of a plan, or any document in the preview pane, the way you comment on a diff, and send those comments back to Claude as the changes you want.

- Press `c` in the preview pane to switch between the rendered document and its numbered source lines. Press a line number to comment on it, another number to extend the comment to a range, write, and press Enter. The header shows how many comments the document has. If the document changes so that a commented line no longer reads the same, the comment moves to the end of the pane marked "(line changed)"; it keeps the text it was written against
- On a plan desk-plan's card is asking about, `3` on the card (also on the short card without a `Changes` field) sends the comments, each with its line numbers and the lines it points at, together with anything written in `Changes`. Claude stays in plan mode, revises those lines and asks again, and the sent comments are cleared. The hint line shows `3` once there is a comment, and `(c comment lines)` before that
- Comments left when you approve the plan, and comments on any other document, go to Claude with your next prompt, like diff line comments (the `✎ N` chip under the prompt; pressing it opens the document's source lines)
- Line comments kept across `/reload-plugins` no longer share ids with new ones
- desk-asana, desk-slack and desk-review move to 0.81.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
